subject: Matemática e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Converter representações algébricas de funções polinomiais de 2º grau em representações geométricas no plano cartesiano, distinguindo os casos nos quais uma variável for diretamente proporcional ao quadrado da outra, recorrendo ou não a softwares ou aplicativos de álgebra e geometria dinâmica, entre outros materiais.

components.description_pt: Converter representação algébrica de função polinomial de segundo grau em seu gráfico cartesiano
components.description_en: Convert the algebraic representation of a second-degree polynomial function into its graph in the Cartesian plane
components.cc_component_description: Use the zeros of a polynomial function to sketch a graph of the function

components.description_pt: Identificar casos em que uma variável é diretamente proporcional ao quadrado da outra
components.description_en: Identify cases in which one variable is directly proportional to the square of the other from a quadratic expression
components.cc_component_description: Identify the different parts of a quadratic expression and explain their meaning within the context of a problem

components.description_pt: Distinguir diferentes formas de funções quadráticas analisando suas representações geométricas
components.description_en: Distinguish between different forms of quadratic functions by analyzing their geometric representations
components.cc_component_description: Compare the key features of two quadratic functions represented in different ways

components.description_pt: Usar software de geometria dinâmica para explorar comportamento gráfico de funções polinomiais de segundo grau
components.description_en: Use dynamic geometry software or algebra tools to explore the graphical behavior of second-degree polynomial functions
components.cc_component_description: Select appropriate tools such as graphing calculators or dynamic software for a given mathematical task

cc_matches.description: Identify zeros of polynomials when suitable factorizations are available, and use the zeros to construct a rough graph of the function defined by the polynomial.

Compare properties of two functions each represented in a different way (algebraically, graphically, numerically in tables, or by verbal descriptions). *For example, given a graph of one quadratic function and an algebraic expression for another, say which has the larger maximum.*
Interpret parts of an expression, such as terms, factors, and coefficients.
